items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Rich's band is fine for drum leader... play with Buddy Rich's band

ctx.x: Yeah, uh huh. And of course, the Buddy Rich big band now is excellent. But somehow or other, I feel that these bands are not exactly on the right track to carry the thing forward from where Kenton was at.

Well, the difference is there are no schools for these -- well, when I say 'schools' -- there are no places for young people to play like you said, where $e$even could go where they could sit in and play and get the exercise of improvising. Now you can go to school and read, and ..
